system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Tamer, Knight, Coachman, or Nomad.

You receive one basic item that has the [Summon] tag with an IR no greater than your [CR-2 (minimum 1)].
(SR 2):  You can receive an item with an IR up to your CR.
(Connection: Warrior, Noble, Farmer): The fate cost is gone.

A feat that allows you to form a deep bond with your mount through training, and obtain a whistle to summon your mount as proof.
